definitions: To extinguish a flame, especially with a puff of air.
To burst or cause to burst, especially a tire.
To defeat decisively in a competition.
To spend a large amount of money, often extravagantly.
examples: She managed to blow out all the candles on her birthday cake.
The car had a flat tire; it blew out on the highway.
Our team blew out the competition in the final game.
They decided to blow out their savings on a luxurious vacation.
